metric_definitions.ap_rank: mean precision at each positive; ties keep input order
metric_definitions.ap_grouped: sklearn-style AP; one PR point per unique score
metric_definitions.pr_auc_trapz: trapezoidal area under grouped PR curve including (0,1)
metric_definitions.AcquireDerm: adjacent-record dermoscopy-presence onset; not a logged clinician action
metric_definitions.prev0: previous chained record has no dermoscopy id; not lifetime-null
metric_definitions.never_derm_before: no dermoscopy id on any earlier chained record

history_vector: naevus count / freckling / prior excision / family history from participant meta
actual_features.note: Empty participant meta zeroes the numeric patient fields.

exclude_chain_first_protocol.rescore: model trained on all train records; score test chain_index>0
exclude_chain_first_protocol.retrain: train on train chain_index>0 and prev0; score the same test subset
